nota:
The date inputs (#br-input-8 and #br-input-9) currently do not have a name that a screen reader can read.

When a screen reader focuses on these fields, it will likely only announce "Date" or "Edit text," providing no context to the user about what date (e.g., "Start Date" or "End Date") is being requested.

Root Cause
The inputs are encapsulated within custom br-input elements. While they are correctly identified as date types, they lack the necessary attributes—such as an aria-label, title, or a correctly associated <label>—to provide a descriptive name in the accessibility tree.
